feature_documentation.duration_months: Longer terms expose the lender to more future income shocks.
feature_documentation.credit_amount: Larger exposures are harder to service and to recover.
feature_documentation.installment_rate_pct_income: Debt-service burden: instalment as a share of disposable income.
feature_documentation.age_years: Proxy for career stage and accumulated financial buffer.
feature_documentation.existing_credits_count: Existing debt burden across the banking system.
feature_documentation.present_residence_since: Residential stability, a classic behavioural stability signal.
feature_documentation.dependents: More dependents reduce income available for debt service.
feature_documentation.monthly_installment_estimate: credit_amount / duration_months - the actual monthly cash outflow.
feature_documentation.log_credit_amount: Log exposure compresses the long right tail of loan sizes.
feature_documentation.loan_to_age_ratio: Exposure relative to age; a large loan early in a career is riskier.
feature_documentation.duration_years: Term expressed in years for interpretability.
feature_documentation.debt_service_burden: installment_rate x existing_credits - combined servicing pressure.
feature_documentation.residual_income_share: 100 - instalment rate: share of income left after servicing this loan.
feature_documentation.employment_stability_score: Ordinal tenure score; stable employment lowers default risk.
feature_documentation.savings_score: Liquid savings buffer available to absorb shocks.
feature_documentation.checking_score: Checking-account standing; overdrafts signal cash-flow stress.
feature_documentation.has_collateral: Real estate or life insurance reduces loss given default.
feature_documentation.has_guarantor: Guarantor or co-applicant adds a secondary source of repayment.
feature_documentation.has_other_installment_plans: Parallel instalment plans increase total debt burden.
feature_documentation.credit_utilisation_proxy: Monthly outflow scaled by instalment rate - utilisation intensity.
